claims.statement: Aiming to achieve high single-digit volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% going forward.
claims.quote: high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8 -10%, as we predict going forward.

claims.statement: Maintaining the operating margin guidance in the 18-20% range.
claims.quote: maintaining our margin guidance, which is there. We are looking at the price increases that are happening and trying to see that we get into that area of 8-10% volume growth.

claims.statement: Industrial coatings will continue to grow faster than decorative coatings due to infrastructure investments.
claims.quote: Industrial coatings will continue to grow much higher than decorative, given the investment happening in the infrastructure and Government spending that is happening in this area.

claims.statement: International business is expected to continue growing and contribute to overall growth.
claims.quote: International business again is expected to continue to grow and therefore, both industrial and international will strongly contribute to our growth going forward, as far as Q1 is concerned.

claims.statement: Planning to implement further price increases to combat inflation.
claims.quote: We are looking at further price increases, which might happen in the market, as we go ahead.

facts.statement: The company declared a final dividend of Rs. 23 per share, bringing the total dividend for the year to Rs. 27.5 per share with a 60% payout ratio.
facts.quote: The final dividend would be Rs. 23 per share, and there was an interim dividend which we had already declared at Rs. 4.5 per share. If we look at the total dividend for the year it becomes Rs. 27.5 per share, and the payout is about 60% ratio.

facts.statement: The company trained more than 9 lakh people through the Beautiful Homes Academy.
facts.quote: More than 9 lakh people we have really trained and that is something which has been the hallmark of a service which we are offering.

facts.statement: Competitive intensity remains strong with persistent discounting across retailers and contractors.
facts.quote: today the discounting intensity stays whether it is retailers, whether it is contractors, whether it is other stakeholders, and therefore what we see very clearly is that, whether it is existing players, whether it is new players, the intensity of that continues

facts.statement: The company has taken cumulative price increases of close to 10.5% to 11%.
facts.quote: where we have already taken close to about 10.5-11% price increase
